newsitem.title: UK: Italy to haunt euro regardless of timing - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Italy to haunt euro regardless of timing - analysts.

text.p: Any plan to delay Italy's entry into European monetary union might make the euro easier to swallow in Germany, but analysts said on Wednesday the end result would be the same -- a euro made weaker by the lira.
A delay might hinder Italy's attempts to influence monetary policy initially but analysts said Italy is likely to join Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU) early next century.
A euro that is more wobbly than the mark -- and interest rates that are higher than Germany and other core European countries might like -- are likely to follow, they said.
"It doesn't actually make the euro any harder from day one because these countries are going to join anyway," said Steven Major, head of bond research at Credit Lyonnais in London.
